content:
olivia: Opening a tiny PR to add a short HSM key-rotation checklist to the private installer docs. Also adding a note about SNAT behavior for VPC NAT gateways and a Windows agent caveat for iptables-nft translation. Need quick eyes on wording + the example SSH tunnel.

dario: Nice. For the rotation checklist, can we include an explicit step to drain HSM clients before rotating keys? Some vendors are sensitive to simultaneous opens.

kevin: Agreed with drain. Also suggest adding a command example for rotating using the vendor CLI (redacted):

```
# vendor-cli rotate-key --hsm-id hsm-01 --wait-for-confirmation
# wait until all client sessions show 'idle' in vendor status
```

olivia: Good call, will add a drain step and the placeholder CLI. I'm also including a short SNAT troubleshooting note: if you see asymmetric routes after enabling NAT, check the customer gateway route advertisement and ensure reply traffic uses the same egress path.

dario: For the Windows agent note: some installers ship with legacy iptables frontends on Windows Server containers; suggested text: "If using the Windows node agent in container mode, validate firewall rules; legacy iptables frontends may not translate nftables rules as expected."

kevin: Left a small comment to avoid suggesting concrete IPs in examples; replaced with mgmt CIDR placeholders (e.g., 10.254.0.0/22).

olivia: Added the placeholders. Also added a tiny nftables snippet for the air-gapped appendix (keeps it minimal):

```
# allow mgmt CIDR -> KMS (HTTPS)
nft add table inet redwood
nft add chain inet redwood forward { type filter hook forward priority 0; }
# accept new+established from mgmt CIDR
nft add rule inet redwood forward ip saddr 10.254.0.0/22 tcp dport 443 ct state new,established accept
nft add rule inet redwood forward ct state established,related accept
```

dario: Looks fine. Can you add a one-line: "Run in non-prod or ensure you have console access to recover network state"? Saves on-call time.

ops-bot: Note: security team requested we avoid publishing vendor-specific private key examples; docs PR should use placeholders.

kevin: Confirmed; PR uses placeholders and env var examples instead of inline secrets.

docs-ci-bot: linkcheck found 1 external URL flagged (vendor CLI docs). Spellcheck ok. Markdown lint: heading-level warning.

olivia: I'll update the vendor URL to the archived doc and re-run CI, fix the heading level. Plan to merge once CI green and then post a short note in #support about the HSM rotation checklist and SNAT caveat.

dario: +1

kevin: +1

olivia: Thanks everyone, pushing fixes now.
